product_one_liner.value: WellnessLiving is an all-in-one business-management platform for fitness, wellness, health, and beauty businesses, providing online booking, client management, payments, marketing, loyalty, reporting, and AI-powered tools.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists plans and monthly prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in WellnessLiving customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile specifies Thornhill, Ontario, Canada.

founded_year.notes: Follows the year stated in the company’s funding announcement.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog has at least two posts on how the platform was built and its infrastructure, featuring its VP of Engineering and Chief Architect.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center includes API documentation and other product/security articles, and links to a Developer Portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is for an AI Solutions Engineer.

model_provider.notes: These are the providers publicly named for the respective AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The page describes WellnessLiving’s SOC 2 and HIPAA audits/compliance; ISO 27001 is attributed to AWS, while PCI-DSS is handled by merchant-processing partners.

value.stage: Minority growth investment and growth financing

last_funding.notes: The company reported a $46 million minority investment and $20 million in growth financing, totaling US$66 million; the funding profile identifies August 2022 as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was in August 2022, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current Business Development Representative posting is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: The announcement gives CAASI Chat Agent and Phone Agent general availability on July 28, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page profiles the CEO and COO but is not a full leadership roster; the Don Williams announcement gives an appointment date in January 2023, outside the window. The available evidence does not establish whether another C-level or VP-level join or departure occurred in the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting names Salesforce; the Sales Operations Manager posting names Zoho CRM.
